### Token Identity
Bitcoin (BTC) is the longest-running proof-of-work layer 1 network, launched on July 13, 2010, and currently ranked #1 by total market capitalization. It is classified as a mineable native coin with no associated smart contract platform, tagged as a store of value, and recognized as a digital commodity under U.S. regulatory frameworks, with broad inclusion across major institutional crypto fund portfolios.

### Market Context
The latest market snapshot shows BTC trading at ~$83,864.73, with a total market capitalization of ~$1.685 trillion. Fully diluted valuation stands at ~$1.761 trillion, consistent with the vast majority of Bitcoin's maximum supply already being in circulation. 24h trading volume is ~$35.66 billion, equal to a 2.12% volume-to-market-cap ratio.

Recent price performance: +0.3% over the trailing 24 hours, -0.52% over 7 days, +6.08% over 30 days, and +36.01% over the trailing 90 days.

No ownership concentration or distribution claims can be confirmed from available context.

These gaps limit the strength of any fundamental assessment relying on ownership distribution or long-term protocol performance trends, and should not be interpreted as implicit positive or negative signals.
